description: Is this x402 seller live RIGHT NOW? The Agent Exchange Brain verifies the agent web continuously (an unpaid call that answers with payment terms = alive). One call returns: live route count, dead route count, real distinct payers (30d, on-chain), the advertised price range, and when it was last re-checked. Use before paying any seller — the published census says only 8.8% of declared endpoints are live; do not pay a dead one. Params: host.
name: get_verify
